violations.title: Food Storage Container, Common Name
violations.observation: The following food items that are not easily identified by appearance were observed without a label: squeeze bottles of ranch, buffalo sauce, barbecue sauce in 3 DR prep cooler.
violations.corrective_action: Unless a food item can be easily recognized, all foods and ingredients removed from their original containers and stored in working containers shall be labeled using the common name of the food. For example: cooking oils, salt, sugar, flour, spices, herbs, etc. PIC labeled squeeze bottles of ranch, barbecue sauce, buffalo sauce.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: observed that the sanitizer dispenser is not dispensing sufficient sanitizer concentration for proper dish-ware sanitizing. (quaternary ammonia -less than 100ppm).
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC contacted a technician during the inspection. PIC will provide an invoice to EHS upon completion of the repair. PIC set up sanitizer with adequate concentration of chlorine bleach in the 3 compartment sink to adequately sanitize all food contact equipment.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Test Kit/Device for Chemical Sanitizer
violations.observation: There is no chlorine test kit located in the facility for monitoring the concentration of the chemical sanitizing solutions.
violations.corrective_action: PIC obtained a chlorine test kit.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: Observed burnt out light bulbs under the hood at the cook line.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. PIC replaced the light bulbs during the inspection.

out_items.name: Management, food employee and conditional employee; knowledge, responsibilities and reporting

violations.title: Duty of PIC, Employee Health Policy in Place
violations.observation: Observed no signed Employee Illness Reporting Agreements.
violations.corrective_action: A complete employee health policy must have the following elements: 1) Employee training on foodborne illness, particularly symptoms of illness and prevention of the Big Six illnesses (see 'What is Foodborne Illness' handout); and 2) Documentation that employees have been instructed of their responsibility to report symptoms of, diagnosis of or exposure to foodborne illness to management (see 'Employee Illness Reporting Agreement' handout); and 3) A management plan to restrict or exclude employees, as applicable, who have symptoms, diagnosis or exposure to foodborne illness (see 'Employee Illness Decision Guide for PIC/CFM' handout). The information provided at the time of this inspection will help you develop and implement this policy. EHS handed management staff the Employee Illness Reporting Agreements in both English and Spanish to be signed and acknowledged immediately.

out_items.name: Procedures for responding to vomiting and diarrheal events

violations.title: Clean-up of vomiting and diarrheal events
violations.observation: The food establishment does not have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events. Pic did not have written vomit and diarrhea cleanup in place during time of inspection
violations.corrective_action: A food establishment shall have written procedures for employees to follow when responding to vomiting or diarrheal events that involve the discharge of vomitus or fecal matter onto surfaces in the food establishment. The procedures shall address the specific actions employees must take to minimize the spread of contamination and the exposure of employees, consumers, food and surfaces to vomitus or fecal matter. EHS provided a copy to the PIC

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Paper Towels Provided
violations.observation: Observed that paper towels were not provided at each handwashing sink. EHS observed no paper towels in the employee restrooms and bar hand sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide paper towels at each hand sink to allow employees to properly dry their hands after handwashing. PIC replaced the paper towels in the employee restroom and bar hand sink Ibiza Bar & Grill (Inspection Date: 11/08/2024) Page 2 of 4

violations.title: Handwashing Cleanser, Availability
violations.observation: Observed that hand soap was not provided at each handwashing sink. EHS observed no hand soap at the bar hand sink
violations.corrective_action: Provide hand soap at each hand sink to allow employees to properly wash their hands. PIC provided hand soap at the bar hand sink

violations.title: RTE TCS Commercially Processed Food, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is commercially processed is not used or discarded within 24 hours of when the original container was opened and is not observed to be date marked: EHS observed commercially processed salsa opened over 24 hrs without date marking
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety commercially processed foods when opened and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of the original container was opened. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. This date cannot exceed any manufacturer determined 'use-by' date based on food safety. PIC date marked salsa and agreed to date mark RTE food containers.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Separation of Poison/Toxic Materials
violations.observation: Observed that poisonous and toxic materials are not properly stored to prevent the contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single service items. EHS observed chemicals being stored above RTE cocktail mixes in the dry storage area
violations.corrective_action: All poisonous and toxic materials shall be stored to prevent contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items by separating the poisonous and toxic materials by spacing or partitioning. PIC moved the RTE cocktail mixes away from the chemical storage area

out_items.name: Contamination prevented during food preparation, storage, and display

violations.title: Food Storage 6 inches above Floor
violations.observation: Food stored on the floor and/or food stored less than 6 inches off the floor. EHS observed food being stored on the floor in the walk in cooler and walk in freezer
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from contamination by storing the food at least 6 inches off the floor on approved shelving units or dunnage racks. Milk crates, soda crates, or bread racks are not suitable for food storage. PIC agreed to acquire more shelving for food storage and will ensure food is stored off the floor by the next inspection.

out_items.name: Single-use/single-service articles properly stored and used

violations.title: Single-Service/Use Items, Stored off Floor, Clean Location
violations.observation: EHS observed single service Items being stored on the floor of the dry storage area
violations.corrective_action: Store clean equipment, utensils, and linens in a clean, dry location where they are not exposed to splash, dust, or other contamination and at least 6 inches above the floor. PIC agreed to move the single service items off the floor of the dry storage area, also agreed to acquire more shelving units for the dry storage area before the next inspection.

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Covered Receptacle in Women's Toilet
violations.observation: There is no covered refuse container for the disposal of feminine napkins in the ladies room stall. EHS observed no covered trash can in the employee bathroom
violations.corrective_action: A toilet room used by females shall be provided with a covered receptacle for sanitary napkins. PIC agreed to acquire a covered trash can for the employees restroom before the next inspection.

out_items.name: Garbage and refuse properly disposed, facilities maintained

violations.title: Receptacles, Provided for Paper Towel Disposal
violations.observation: There is no refuse container at the area immediately adjacent to all kitchen area hand sinks.
violations.corrective_action: If disposable paper towels are used at handwashing sinks, a trash can shall be located at each sink or group of adjacent sinks. EHS instructed management to provide small trash cans at each hand sink for disposal of paper towels. Ensure correction before the next inspection.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Physical Facilities, Maintain Good Repair
violations.observation: EHS observed holes in ceiling in the kitchen area adjacent to the cook/prep line
violations.corrective_action: Repair the physical facilities. Poor repair and maintenance compromises the functionality of the physical facilities. Pic agreed to have the ceiling area repaired before the next inspection.
